blocks.text: Matthew presents Jesus’ wilderness testing as a test of Spirit-marked sonship: each challenge is answered through Scripture, with Deuteronomy shaping Jesus’ responses. Scripture also frames the move to Capernaum, while the chapter’s public ministry joins the announcement that the kingdom of heaven has drawn near with teaching, healing, and exorcism. Together, these scenes present Jesus’ words and actions within Matthew’s scriptural and ancient understanding of bodies and spirits.
